FarewellBanner.label: Blog retirement notice
FarewellBanner.message: Thanks for following the blog all these years. It's been retired, and this site is now my home for places, games, NBA, and music.

places.title: Where the camera has been.
places.intro: Every pin is a place I've visited, alongside the photos I brought back. Most are also available on <unsplash>Unsplash</unsplash> and <pexels>Pexels</pexels>, free to use.

globe.description: A 3D dotted globe you can rotate, featuring photo pins of places I've visited. Use the arrow keys to rotate.
globe.hint: drag to rotate · click to open a pin

games.title: Press start.
games.intro: What I'm playing, what I've beaten, and what's next. Got a game recommendation for me? Let me know.

nba.title: Courtside.
nba.intro: I watch way too much basketball, so I built the NBA app I wanted to open every night: scores, standings, and playoffs, with no annoying ads and nothing more than what's needed.

game.title: Take a shot
game.hint: Pull the ball back, aim, release.
game.onFireHint: You're on fire. Keep it up.
game.canvasDescription: Basketball mini-game: pull the ball back and release to shoot. On keyboard, hold Space to build power, use up and down arrow keys to change angle, and release Space to shoot.
game.keyboardAim: angle {angle}°  ·  ↑↓ to aim, release Space to shoot
